text:
deploy-bot: Kicking off regional rollout v3.5.0 -> order: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary: US 3% then EU 2% then APAC 0.5%. Change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC.
rachel: US smoke passed on canary slice. p50 ~ 45ms, p95 ~ 170ms. Warm pools healthy.
tom: EU warm pools showing CPU pressure on a subset of hosts (containers at ~78%). Not critical yet. any batch cron running?
akira: APAC reported sustained GPU util ~92% yesterday on g5. We'll keep APAC minimal. Recommend hold until EU stable.
release-coordinator: Agreed. Sequence: progress US -> observe 15m -> ramp EU -> observe 20m -> consider APAC 0.5%.
rachel: Ops, we need pin/rollback criteria. Suggest: auto-pin to previous model v3.4.9 if inference.p95 > 250ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows or error_rate > 0.5%.
ops-bot: Rollback rule created: scope=eu,apac threshold_p95=250ms consecutive_buckets=2 error_rate_threshold=0.5% action=pin model=v3.4.9 owner=@ops.
tom: Also set OOM trigger: if any OOM on runtime node in 10m -> immediate drain and pin.
ops-bot: OOM trigger rule added: scope=apac action=drain+pin owner=@infra.
rachel: Changing warm pool eviction for rollout tag to 25m for APAC to avoid noisy churn during small canary.
akira: noted. APAC canary slice set to 0.5% and will not start until EU steady for 30m.
deploy-bot: US ramp to 3% now. Running canary tests: chat, structured outputs, streaming.
rachel: US reports: basic flows ok. p95 175ms currently. No errors.
tom: EU ramp to 2% scheduled in +18m. I'll watch autoscaler metrics and pod restarts.
release-coordinator: Heads-up to customer success: draft blurb ready. Add line about rollback safety net and minimal APAC exposure.
akira: Small ops ask: increase warm-pool buffer count by +2 in EU during ramp to smooth spikes.
rachel: Done (tags: rollout-2799999500-eu). Buffer updated.
ops-bot: Alert: inference.p95.latency.prepage EU = 205ms (threshold 200ms). No page. Monitoring.
tom: Seeing a tail on a specific model shard. Increasing sample traces. If p95 crosses 250ms next window we rollback.
ops-bot: Trigger: inference.p95.latency EU breached 250ms for 2nd 5m bucket. Executing rollback -> pin to v3.4.9.
deploy-bot: EU route pinned to v3.4.9. Draining v3.5.0 instances in EU. Change log: rollback applied at +47m.
rachel: EU baseline restored. p95 back to ~160ms after pin. Opening ENG-5010 to investigate fallback kernel interactions.
release-coordinator: APAC remains on hold. We'll re-evaluate in 30m. Uploading traces and logs to s3://redwood-rollouts/2799999500/traces/.
akira: Please extend scheduled warm-pool eviction to 40m for APAC while we watch.
rachel: Extended. Tag=rollout-2799999500-apac.
release-coordinator: Notes for release notes: "v3.5.0: runtime optimizer changes + attention kernel fallback. Rolling release: US successful canary; EU rolled backed to v3.4.9 due to p95 tail; APAC deferred pending follow-up. Expected cost neutral."
ops-bot: Postmortem ticket ENG-5010 created. Assignee=@infra. Artifacts attached.
deploy-bot: Final status: US=active v3.5.0 (canary 3%), EU=rolled back->v3.4.9, APAC=deferred (0.5% hold). Closing thread unless new alerts.
release-coordinator: Thanks all. Will send a short ops recap and customer note. :pray:
